verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs confirm payout-related data (payout frequency, currencies, reporting dashboard for balances/sales/payouts, platform split-payment holding) and an MCP server for natural-language API access, suggesting the underlying data exists and could be queried programmatically, but there is no explicit documentation of a payout/balance-transaction API endpoint or a reconciliation workflow that maps deposits to underlying charges. Missing for 10: explicit balance-transaction/payout API reference, documented reconciliation report structure, and any example of an agent programmatically matching payouts to charges.
